sources.section: Named family sections in the wine catalog
sources.facts: The producer lists Evolution, Khrustaleva 76, Purity, Toile de Vin, Marquetry, Appassimento and Blush. Evolution Reserve and sparkling Evolution are listed separately. Additional current families are outside this snapshot-centered subset.

sources.section: Purity in balance 2025: grape composition and production
sources.facts: The official card identifies a dry white blend of Chenin Blanc and Pinot Gris, distinct from the saved single-variety Purity in Chenin Blanc.
